name: SubPro S-16
tagline: Ultra High-Speed Industrial Sublimation Transfer Printer

keySpecification.description: Advanced industrial textile printing technology designed to maximize productivity, ensure superior color accuracy, and support diverse fabric applications.

inkCompatibility.description: Designed to support multiple ink technologies, offering flexibility for various fabric types while maintaining exceptional print quality and durability.

inkTypes.name: Sublimation
inkTypes.fabrics: Polyester · Synthetic Blends · Transfer Paper for heat press transfer to polyester fabrics

features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 24 Epson i3200-A1 Printheads
items.desc: Twenty-four industrial Epson i3200-A1 heads deliver up to 19,500 lm/day, making the SubPro S-16 the highest-output sublimation printer in the SubPro series for non-stop industrial-scale production.

items.title: High-Speed 1-Pass Architecture
items.desc: Single-pass configuration eliminates multi-pass carriage return delays, enabling continuous, uninterrupted sublimation output at maximum daily volumes across both transfer paper and direct polyester fabric.

items.title: Maglev Linear Motor Carriage System
items.desc: Magnetic levitation linear motor drives the 24-head carriage with ultra-smooth, vibration-free movement, maintaining consistent ink placement accuracy and registration across the full print width at production speed.

items.title: Multi-Stage Intelligent Drying System
items.desc: Advanced multi-zone drying with real-time temperature management ensures rapid, uniform ink fixation at all production speeds, preventing underdrying and maintaining consistent transfer quality on every metre.

items.title: Ultra-Thin Paper Compatibility
items.desc: Engineered media handling system supports lightweight and ultra-thin sublimation transfer papers, reducing per-metre media cost without compromising colour accuracy, transfer quality, or feeding stability.

items.title: Jumbo Roll Unwinding and Winding System
items.desc: High-capacity roll support enables extended non-stop production batches, minimising roll change frequency and operator intervention during sustained high-volume shifts.

items.title: Automated Printhead Moisture and Cleaning System
items.desc: Sealed automated cleaning and moisture control maintains consistent nozzle performance across all 24 heads throughout long production shifts without manual intervention between jobs.

items.title: Precision Servo-Controlled Media Transport
items.desc: Industrial servo-driven feed and take-up system with tension management delivers stable, wrinkle-free media transport and accurate winding at all production speeds across different paper weights.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Maximum-Volume Sublimation Transfer Paper Production
fabrics.desc: The highest-output SubPro machine for manufacturers supplying very large volumes of printed sublimation paper to heat press operations across polyester garment, fashion fabric, and activewear markets.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Polyester Fashion Fabric Printing
fabrics.desc: Direct sublimation output on polyester sarees, dress materials, and fashion fabrics for large wholesale and export operations where maximum daily output and colour repeatability are both essential.

fabrics.title: Industrial Sportswear and Activewear Production
fabrics.desc: High-speed, high-volume sublimation on polyester performance fabrics for major sportswear brands, gym wear producers, and activewear exporters with continuous large-order production requirements.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Home Textile Sublimation Production
fabrics.desc: Very high-capacity sublimation printing on polyester curtains, cushion covers, upholstery, and decorative soft furnishings for large domestic and export home textile manufacturers.

fabrics.title: 24/7 Continuous Round-the-Clock Operations
fabrics.desc: Maglev carriage, automated maintenance, servo media handling, and jumbo roll support are purpose-built for facilities running continuous multi-shift production schedules at maximum output.

fabrics.title: Integrated Mills and Dedicated Print Houses
fabrics.desc: Vertically integrated manufacturers and large-scale print houses who need sublimation output volumes that match or exceed downstream heat press, finishing, and dispatch capacities.

fabrics.title: Large Job Work and Multi-Buyer Sublimation Units
fabrics.desc: The highest daily output in the SubPro range makes the S-16 the definitive choice for large job work printers managing very high-volume, diverse client order portfolios across polyester and transfer paper substrates.
